newsitem.title: USA: MBIA acquires investment advisory firm.
newsitem.headline: MBIA acquires investment advisory firm.

text.p: MBIA Inc's MBIA Municipal Investors Service said on Tuesday that it has acquired American Money Management Associates Inc, a Denver-based manager of $1.2 billion in assets.
Terms of the deal were not immediately available.
The acquisition is an expansion of MBIA's money management services for state and local governments, MBIA said.
MBIA Municipal Investors presently provides investment management for 1,700 public entities with an aggregate of more than $3.1 billion in assets, it said.
An MBIA spokesman said terms of the deal were not disclosed.
